BCGA-M1.description: Boundary Change Assignment (BCGA-M1). A model-wide singleton (key 1): BC_ASSIGN maps each analysis/load case to a Boundary Group Combination, and BC_SELECT lists which boundary-condition categories the change applies to.

BC_ASSIGN.description: Boundary Change assignment list. One entry per analysis or load case that should use a specific Boundary Group Combination; load cases not listed remain unchanged.

ANAL_TYPE.description: Analysis / load case type (case-insensitive). ST=Static Load Case, MV=Moving Load Analysis, SM=Settlement Analysis, EIGV=Eigenvalue Analysis, RS=Response Spectrum Analysis, LTH=Linear Time History Analysis, NLTH=Nonlinear Time History Analysis, PO=Pushover Analysis.

LCNAME.description: [ANAL_TYPE=ST|NLTH|PO] Load case name. The handler requires it and resolves it to a Static/Nonlinear-Time-History/Pushover load case for ST, NLTH, and PO; it is ignored for MV, SM, EIGV, RS, and LTH (those types identify their single analysis directly).

BGCNAME.description: Boundary Group Combination name. Must match an existing Boundary Group Combination in the model, otherwise the request fails.

BC_SELECT.description: Boundary-condition categories the boundary change is applied to (case-insensitive). SSSF=Section Stiffness Scale Factor, ES=Element Stiffness Scale Factor, EW=Effective Width Scale Factor, PS=Plate Stiffness Scale Factor, SP=Support, PSS=Point Spring Support, GSS=General Spring Support, SSS=Surface Spring Support, EL=Elastic Link, RL=Rigid Link, GL=General Link, CGL=Change General Link Property, BER=Beam End Release, BEO=Beam End Offset, PER=Plate End Release, LC=Linear Constraints.
